<title level="1" right="Class Feature 1">[Flurry of Blows](/Classes.aspx?ID=8)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 154

**Class** Monk
</column>

---

You can attack rapidly with fists, feet, elbows, knees, and other unarmed attacks. You gain the Flurry of Blows action.
